description.narrative: Project Outcomes - Supplier Effects Increased Access to Clients and Improved Efficiency via Adoption of Digital Technologies: The Project will facilitate local suppliers/retailers access to a wider and more reliable customer base, which will contribute to strengthening the supply chain in the region. Furthermore, MSME merchants will also benefit from the improved operational efficiency via adoption of digital merchant solutions. Market Creation Integration: The Project will promote greater integration of domestic suppliers by helping them to reach buyers beyond their traditional customer base. The success of the Project could help boost confidence in online businesses, potentially scaling up business opportunities for smaller retailers in the region.

The Project consists of an up to US$150 million equity linked notes issuance whose proceeds will support PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GoTo or Company) of which it is proposed that IFC invests up to US$125 million as an anchor investor. The proceeds will be utilized to strengthen and grow the Companys offering across its three business segments including e-commerce, on-demand services (transport and food delivery) and financial solutions, and further promote the unique integrated technology solutions business model of GoTo.
